1. Item 4 (employment records) — the time window you've drawn covers eight years prior to the incident. I'd ask we narrow that to three; happy to discuss the reasoning.
2. Item 9 (prior medical) — this overlaps with the request you sent in March, which we've already produced. I'll re-send rather than re-collect.

Call me when you have a few minutes.
